status: frozen after V19CB and while V19W response production remained active, before V19BQ/V19BS source disposition, before selecting or deriving an action, before fixing universal constants, before opening any new galaxy or cluster target, and before detailed Solar-System optimization
purpose: Turn the broad dark-matter phenomenology roadmap into quantitative no-retuning tests, with diverse galaxies and clusters first, weak lensing and merger geometry next, and Solar-System work retained as a later hard veto.

priority_order.advance_when: The frozen action passes the registered galaxy morphology gate and raw strong-lensing gate across relaxed and disturbed clusters.
The same constants pass resolved weak-lensing, magnification, joint dynamics/lensing, and merger-direction gates without a new amplitude, orientation, scale, or source law.
A three-dimensional time-dependent solution predicts environmental satellite dynamics, stream observables, and the destination of orbital energy.
The covariant action supplies a background solution and perturbation equations for growth, cosmic shear, cluster abundance, and the CMB.
The already successful broad candidate passes Solar-System, binary, wave-speed, conservation, stability, causality, and well-posedness gates.

score_definitions.covariance_deviance: D_model = (y - y_model)^T C^{-1} (y - y_model), evaluated in the raw observable space with the same masks, nuisance priors, and covariance for Sigma, baryons-only, MOND/RAR where defined, and the conventional halo comparator.
score_definitions.baryon_to_halo_gap_closure: F_close = 1 - (D_Sigma - D_halo)/(D_baryon - D_halo), reported only when D_baryon > D_halo; values below zero and above one are retained rather than clipped.
score_definitions.axial_angle_error: Delta_theta_ax = min(|Delta_theta|, 180 degrees - |Delta_theta|), with the source-predicted axis frozen before lensing is opened.
score_definitions.parameter_counting: Count universal physical constants, globally fitted nuisance hyperparameters, and per-system nuisance parameters separately; any per-system gravity amplitude, range, exponent, shear, orientation, or object label is a hard failure.

near_term_quantitative_gates.failure_meaning: The frozen metric has the wrong amplitude or two-dimensional curvature outside strong-lens cores; a weak-lensing-only multiplier is forbidden.
A galaxy rotation success does not transfer to the same metric potential on larger projected radii.
The candidate is solving motion and light with effectively different laws even if separate aggregate fits look acceptable.
The baryonic state may be measurable but it points the metric curvature in the wrong place or direction.

broader_prediction_dispositions.required_theory: three-dimensional nonlinear field plus massive-particle geodesics
broader_prediction_dispositions.must_predict: dispersion profiles, escape speeds, tidal radii, and host-distance dependence with no halo or force parameter per satellite
broader_prediction_dispositions.decisive_risk: A purely instantaneous gas thermodynamic source cannot explain gas-poor satellites unless the same action derives a persistent or environmental response.

broader_prediction_dispositions.required_theory: time-dependent nonlinear field and compact-solution stability analysis
broader_prediction_dispositions.must_predict: stream track, precession, width, density perturbations, and lensing flux or astrometric anomalies
broader_prediction_dispositions.decisive_risk: A smooth long mode can alter global precession but does not imitate localized dark subhalos unless compact response structures arise from the equations.

broader_prediction_dispositions.required_theory: action-derived field stress-energy, radiation, retarded response, and backreaction
broader_prediction_dispositions.must_predict: the sign and rate of orbital energy and angular-momentum loss
broader_prediction_dispositions.decisive_risk: A static constitutive law has no physical destination for the missing orbital energy and cannot claim to replace a dark-matter wake.

broader_prediction_dispositions.required_theory: covariant background and scalar-vector-tensor perturbation equations
broader_prediction_dispositions.must_predict: growth rate, slip, redshift-space distortions, cosmic shear, collapse, and abundance with one fixed physical or comoving scale interpretation
broader_prediction_dispositions.decisive_risk: Constants that work only at redshift zero cannot be retuned at each epoch.

broader_prediction_dispositions.required_theory: Boltzmann implementation of the same covariant action
broader_prediction_dispositions.must_predict: acoustic peak positions and heights, early and late ISW effects, damping, and lensing power without cold dark matter
broader_prediction_dispositions.decisive_risk: This is likely the strongest eventual test because early gravitational potentials must exist before late galaxy structure forms.

claim_boundary: Passing V19CC means the cross-scale prediction gates were frozen before the theory was selected; it is not evidence that Sigma Gravity passes them.
I4 and I5 remain registered source candidates until the frozen V19BQ/V19BS chain decides whether either is observable and transferable; this protocol does not admit them.
Raw shape and image catalogs are the validation targets. Halo or convergence maps inferred under a conventional model remain comparators or secondary diagnostics, not truth.
Solar-System work is delayed to avoid tuning the mechanism locally, but no final theory can pass without the local and mathematical vetoes.
